process.worker: DeepSeek — three sub-gates, 10,000 permutation reps, 200 placebo reps, seed 20260808
process.worker_self_verification: independent reimplementation of T_obs (exact), same-seed p reproduction plus an alternate-seed stability run, alternate-seed placebo, Cholesky re-derivation of G2-B
worker_defects_found_and_fixed_during_it: the placebo shuffle drew from an integer LCG stream and produced out-of-range indices, manufacturing 99.7% spurious non-convergence; replaced with a uniform stream
the G2-A half-split assigned the LOW half to H, mirroring the statistic; corrected to the top half, after which it reproduces the committed R3 bi-dimensional sign and magnitude
process.handler_independent_re_derivation: cc, separate implementation including a from-scratch GLS solver, no worker artifact read as input, permutation p-values re-run on seed 77777777 rather than the worker's seed — reproducing a p-value under the same seed only proves the same code ran twice

discrepancy_recorded.what: T_obs is deterministic and should match exactly. It matches only to about two significant figures — S_bp 2020 reads 0.0721 against 0.0675, S_size 2022 reads 0.0668 against 0.0704.
discrepancy_recorded.cause: the frozen criteria said 'cut at the 33.33 and 66.67 percentiles' without naming a percentile convention. Nearest-rank, linear interpolation and lower-index truncation put a handful of firms in different terciles, which moves a count-weighted mean of half-split spreads slightly.
discrepancy_recorded.effect_on_the_gate: none. Both implementations return 5/5 for S_bp and 4/5 for S_size, with the same origin (2019) as the single S_size failure, at p 0.0943 and 0.0895 respectively.
discrepancy_recorded.note: This is the third gate condition weakened by an underspecified phrase, after G0's 'as-reported shares_t' and G1's 'within-sector rank result'.

G2_B_negative_control.result: No leakage signal. All four specifications satisfy both frozen conditions simultaneously — every |t| is below 0.6 against a threshold of 2, and every partial R-squared is at least an order of magnitude below the 0.01 bound. The ICC computed at the origin carries essentially no information about returns that already happened.

G2_C_shuffled_price_placebo.construction: within each origin, price permuted across firms; the ICC re-solved from the permuted price with each cell's own book, forecasts, payout, target ROE and horizon; every other regressor left at its true value

specification_discrepancy_recorded.what: The worker compared the placebo distribution against 0.819823, which is the G1 coefficient from a regression that also contains FEPS1/P and the forecast slope. The frozen G2-C regression is R ~ BP + SIZE + MOM + ICC, without those two. On that specification the observed coefficient is 1.233385.
specification_discrepancy_recorded.effect_on_the_gate: none. The placebo 97.5th percentile is -0.0035 and no rep in either run reaches even zero, so both 0.82 and 1.23 sit far outside the distribution.

G2_C_shuffled_price_placebo.reading: The placebo distribution is centred near -0.14 rather than zero. That is structural, not noise: the shuffled ICC still carries each firm's own book and forecasts, which the true B/P in the same regression also carries, so the fake variable inherits a negative partial association. The relevant fact is that the observed coefficient lies far above the entire distribution, in the same direction, with zero reps reaching it.

verdict.label: G2_PASS

conditions_met.a_permutation: S_bp significant at 5/5 origins and S_size at 4/5, both meeting the frozen 4-of-5 bar, in two independent implementations on different seeds
conditions_met.b_negative_control: no leakage signal on either lookback, by both frozen conditions, with agreement to six decimals between worker and handler
conditions_met.c_placebo: observed coefficient above the 97.5th percentile of the placebo distribution with zero reps reaching it in either run

verdict.the_finding: The G1 result is not a leak and not an artifact of the solve. Randomising the ICC inside comparable firms destroys the return spread; the ICC does not explain returns that already happened; and feeding the solver a fake price does not manufacture the relation — it produces a distribution centred on the wrong side of zero.
evidence_limits: S_size at 2019 fails at p 0.0943 and 0.0895 in the two implementations; the 4-of-5 bar is met exactly, not comfortably
the five origins remain heavily overlapping in their 36-month return windows, so these permutation p-values are within-origin statements and do not aggregate into a five-fold independent test
the placebo distribution's location is construction-dependent, as the worker itself flagged
per-origin permutation inference assumes exchangeability within stratum, which the sector stratification strains at 89-97 excluded cells per origin

prohibitions_observed: no threshold, statistic definition, stratification, rep count or seed changed after any result
no coarser grouping substituted to rescue a stratum
no selection of the best-performing stratification
no change to the GLS equation, forecast equations, fade, terminal horizon, payout policy, industry target or solver
no publication or promotion; the public surface remains quarantined
